answer: Model each account as a vertex in the attestation graph and score establishment not by how many peers vouch, but by how independent those peers are. A sybil farm is a relic of one operator: its vertices interconnect densely yet share few edges with the honest core, so cheap duplicate identities inflate raw count without widening real independence. Make the costly signal the breadth of non-overlapping panels that attest you across many epochs, which a single actor cannot fake by cloning itself.
